about: Agent Behaviour Policy (ABP) for SovereignWebsite__Factory. CI reads this file on every run: a pipeline may take only the actions listed for it, an agent's commits may change only the paths listed for it, and every privilege held by the GitHub App or the AWS role is listed here with its reason. Anything not listed is refused. Changes to this file, to .github/ and to build/ take effect only when Dinis merges them.
source: Dinis, 19 November 2026 ~15:10 UTC in the conductor session recorded in team/keys.json: "let's take the opportunity to add as much automation (via CI pipelines) as possible, and then use our ABP to control it"; "let's try to do this completely from the CI pipeline and if we need to add more privs to the GH App and the AWS Role, we'll add them".

runs_on: push to dev that changes org/ or policy/
hourly schedule (converges: HTTPS once certificates are issued; every sixth hour it also nudges a domain with no certificate)
org-apply.note: A repository that exists but is not in org/repos.json is reported, never deleted. repo.seed only adds files that are missing on dev, never overwrites. pages.nudge_certificate re-sets the same custom domain only when Pages has no certificate or a failed one, so GitHub retries issuing it; it never runs while a certificate is pending.

protection.main: no deletion, no force push, no direct update; only organisation admins (Dinis) bypass, so main moves only when Dinis merges a release
protection.dev: no deletion, no force push; agents push here, and every push runs Checks including the policy path check

org-apply.nudge_source: Dinis, 20 Nov 2026 ~10:20 UTC in the factory.b session: "you have to run that regularly ... until they are stable".
org-apply.rename_note: repo.rename only from a name a request lists as aka (its old Site__<label> or Redirect__<label>) to the name the request gives, Site__[<Group>__]<Name> (Dinis, 20 Nov 2026 ~12:28 UTC). GitHub keeps redirecting the old name.
org-apply.collaborator_note: repo.invite_collaborator: only a GitHub login a site request names under "collaborators", only with push (write), on that site repository only; a login GitHub does not know is reported, never invited. Never admin or maintain (Dinis, 20 Nov 2026 ~14:44 UTC: "hi can you add kateandphilce-jpg as the writer to kate's repo").

runs_on: push to dev that changes org/dns.json
dns-apply.status: active once the apply environment has SW_AWS_ROLE_ARN (a role for this repository) and the three SW_ZONE_ID_* variables
dns-apply.note: UPSERT only, records named in org/dns.json, only in the three sovereignwebsite zones; the AWS role enforces the same limits (docs/aws-oidc.md).
dns-apply.zones_source: Dinis, 20 Nov 2026 ~11:38 UTC in the sites.b session: "we are going to be using sovereignweb.site since that is a better domain (which I just wired up to AWS Hosted Zone)". Its records are written only once SW_ZONE_ID_WEB_SITE is set and the AWS role allows the zone (docs/aws-oidc.md).

runs_on: push to dev that changes a request with a from block
needs: requests/<id>/site.json with a from block and apply "dry-run", merged by Dinis
a dry run whose preflight passed
a second commit setting apply to "real", merged by Dinis
transfer-apply.note: The plan job is read-only (the factory App on AgentiCCells, read). Only the apply job, in the transfer environment, holds the user token, and it makes one call: POST /repos/AgentiCCells/<repo>/transfer with new_owner SovereignWebsite and new_name Site__<label>. Without TRANSFER_USER_TOKEN it prints that call for Dinis to make. The repository list is explicit; adding one is a policy change Dinis merges. Org apply keeps repo.transfer refused.
transfer-apply.controlled_source: Dinis, 20 Nov 2026 ~10:20 UTC in the factory.b session: "you can only do transfers for domains that we control. So you can never do a transfer for a domain outside of our control. That is going to be a separate flow". A move from or to an owner or domain we do not control is refused here; it will be its own pipeline, with a shorter-lived token.
transfer-apply.after_the_move: migration.b@SovereignWebsite.dinis commits the moved-to-SovereignWebsite update in each moved repository, under that repository's own rules (Dinis, 20 Nov 2026 ~10:20 UTC in the factory.b session).
transfer-apply.reviewer_source: Dinis, 20 Nov 2026 ~12:25 UTC in the factory.b session: "I didn't check the required reviewer so let's see if this works end to end automatically". So a real move runs once its second commit (apply "real") lands on dev; the dry run first, the explicit repository list and the controlled owners and domains still apply.

org-apply: create the dev branch and seed files in a new repository
org-apply: turn on GitHub Pages for site repositories
org-apply: seed a new repository's CI workflows

keys_rule: No agent may change its own entry in team/keys.json (build/abp.mjs paths refuses it). The conductor adds and retires its team's keys; only Dinis changes the conductor's key.
